name: NewsQA: Machine Comprehension Dataset
description: NewsQA is a machine comprehension dataset of human-generated question-answer pairs based on CNN news articles. While crowdworkers originally collected 119,633 questions on 12,744 CNN stories, the canonical evaluated machine reading benchmark comprises 102,841 validated question-answer pairs across 10,978 stories.

license.name: MIT License (Annotations) / Proprietary Copyright (CNN Stories)
license.notes: Maluuba/Microsoft released questions and span annotations under the MIT License, but the underlying news articles are copyrighted by CNN; users reconstruct text using provided scripts. Commercial use is not permitted by CNN copyright terms.

source_references.title: NewsQA: A Machine Comprehension Dataset
source_references.notes: Published in Proceedings of the 2nd Workshop on Representation Learning for NLP (RepL4NLP@ACL 2017).

verification.notes: Verified against RepL4NLP 2017 publication (DOI: 10.18653/v1/W17-2623) and official dataset release. Total collection consists of 119,633 questions on 12,744 CNN stories; canonical validated benchmark partitions comprise 102,841 questions (train: 92,549, dev: 5,166, test: 5,126) across 10,978 stories.

size.notes: CSV/JSON question-answer annotations and character offsets.
